# Cyber Kings 2026-11-16 19:40 (modder 19:12): Adonai's hidden parentage. GENERATED by _dev/scripts/oneoff/gen_adonai_secrets.py; design in _dev/ANCIENT_HISTORY_AND_LINEAGES.md 7l.

ck_secret_adonai_father = {
	category = adultery

	# The secret lasts until that parent is publicly known (the father is then set on the child).
	is_valid = {
		exists = scope:secret_target
		scope:secret_target = {
			is_alive = yes
			NOT = { exists = father }
		}
	}

	is_shunned = { always = yes }
	is_criminal = { always = no }

	on_discover = {
		save_scope_as = secret
		scope:secret_target = { save_scope_as = ck_child }
		scope:secret_owner = { save_scope_as = ck_parent }
		scope:discoverer = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				trigger_event = ck_adonai_secret.0001
			}
		}
		# If the child himself finds out, he shares the secret from then on.
		if = {
			limit = { scope:discoverer = scope:ck_child }
			add_secret_participant = scope:discoverer
		}
	}

	on_expose = {
		save_scope_as = secret
		scope:secret_target = { save_scope_as = ck_child }
		scope:secret_owner = { save_scope_as = ck_parent }
		scope:ck_child = {
			set_father = scope:ck_parent
			ck_adonai_parentage_exposed_effect = yes
		}
		every_player = { trigger_event = ck_adonai_secret.0011 }
	}

	on_owner_death = { }
}
